Senses.PreferredTarget: a slip of speech (being caught out / defeated in a dialogue by one's own words)
AlternateTargets: a slip of the tongue that loses the exchange
Senses.Explanation: Literally 'speech-fall' (話 speech + 墮 to fall/drop). Its dominant attested form is a verdict spoken in dialogue -- (話墮也) (164 hits / 58 allowlist files), with second-person forms (汝話墮) (16 / 7), (你話墮) (9 / 5), (爾話墮) (2 / 1), the variant (話墮了也) (32 / 22), and the fixed reply (是汝話墮也) (one exchange, following 如何是好手人, carried in 5 witness files). The one so judged presses back with (什麼處是話墮)/(話墮處) (7 hits / 6 files); the recorded answers to that question are Muzhou's (擔枷過狀萬里崖州自領出去) and Yunmen's (七棒對十三). The word is not reserved to the master's side: monks and commentators say it of a master (和尚話墮也, 6 hits / 6 files -- e.g. X69n1343, where a master raises Yunmen's 話墮也 verdict, asks 爾見什麼處是話墮處, and the monk answers 和尚話墮也); masters say it of themselves (山僧話墮, 2 files; 老僧話墮也。明眼者試辨看, J27nB189), of both parties at once (師曰。彼此話墮, T51n2076), of absent masters (恁麼則趙州話墮。僧便出。師曰：恁麼則山僧話墮, X82n1571; 法眼和尚話墮也不知, X79n1559), and of Bodhidharma (老胡九年話墮。可惜當時放過 -- in Dahui's own record T47n1998A, and 9 hits / 9 files counting retellings); in one exchange the master who declares (爾話墮也) adds (我話亦墮汝作麼生) (one case, 5 witness files). The corpus contains no passage defining the term (no 謂之話墮, 話墮者, or 名為話墮 anywhere in the allowlist); when asked where the slip lies, the masters answer as quoted above. The texts leave (話墮) without gloss, and so does this entry.
Senses.Note: 577 hits across 172 files of the 462-file allowlist (XML tags/notes/rdg stripped, whitespace collapsed, punctuation retained -- all counts in this entry use this convention). The reciprocal uses are two separate cases: (我話亦墮) (the curated Baozi occurrence; one exchange carried in 5 witness files T51n2076, X79n1557, X80n1565, X80n1568, X81n1571) and (彼此話墮) (T51n2076 0401c02: 師問僧。汝念什麼經。曰法華經。師曰。彼此話墮). Curated occurrences span (語錄), (廣錄), (燈錄) and (會元).

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云你為什麼話墮進云什麼處是話墮處師云擔枷過狀萬里崖州自領出去
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Muzhou: (你為什麼話墮) ('why have you slipped?') -- monk: (什麼處是話墮處) ('where is the slip?') -- Muzhou: (擔枷過狀萬里崖州自領出去) ('shoulder the cangue and file your own complaint; take yourself off the ten thousand li to Yazhou').

Occurrences.Kwic: 師云。話墮也。進云。什麼處是話墮。師云。七棒對十三。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: In Yunmen's own Extensive Record: the verdict (話墮也), the monk's (什麼處是話墮) ('where is the slip?'), and the recorded answer (七棒對十三) ('seven blows against thirteen').

Occurrences.Kwic: 師曰。爾話墮也。又曰。我話亦墮汝作麼生。僧無對。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: 景德傳燈錄. Full six-rung exact-turn review identifies Baozi Xiaowu as the exact headword-bearing speaker, author, or grammatical actor for this occurrence.

Occurrences.Kwic: 老胡九年話墮。可惜當時放過。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: Dahui says it of Bodhidharma (老胡, 'the old foreigner') and his nine years facing the wall: 'the old foreigner's nine years -- a speech-fall; a pity it was let pass at the time.' Also in Dahui's own record (老胡九年話墮。可惜當時放過, T47n1998A); 9 hits / 9 files counting retellings.

Occurrences.Kwic: 和尚因甚麼如此。師曰。汝話墮也。
Occurrences.AttributionNote: The verdict form: the monk asks (和尚因甚麼如此) ('why are you like this?'), and Guichen replies (汝話墮也).
